ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v1.0.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
Local TTS Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/archdukejim/Local-Text-to-Speech/wiki
Fully offline, on-device neural text-to-speech, powered by the Kokoro-82M model running through ONNX Runtime. No API keys, no cloud calls, no network required once the model is installed — all synthesis happens on your own machine.
Standalone: no other mod is required. Other mods can request speech through the async broker API — a line is synthesized in the background, staged as an audio file, and the requesting mod is told when it is ready and where.
--- Core Systems --- - Kokoro-82M Neural Voice: A compact, high-quality 82M-parameter TTS model bundled with the mod. Produces natural 24kHz speech entirely on-device. - Automatic Hardware Acceleration: Synthesis runs asynchronously on a background thread so the game never stutters. Uses your GPU via DirectML when a compatible graphics card is present (any DirectX 12 GPU — NVIDIA, AMD, or Intel), and falls back to multi-threaded CPU inference otherwise. - Async Broker API: Any mod can request a line; the audio file is generated and staged in the background, with a ready-notification when it can be played. - 29 Voices with Blending: Pick any bundled voice, blend two for a custom timbre, and audition any line from the mod settings. - Espeak-ng Phonemization: Bundled grapheme-to-phoneme conversion turns arbitrary English text into the phonemes Kokoro expects.
--- Requirements --- - Windows 64-bit - ~350 MB free disk space for the bundled model
--- RimSynapse --- Works standalone. When RimSynapse Core is installed, Local TTS additionally reports its GPU memory footprint to Core's GPU stats channel.
--- Note --- Fully local: no text or audio ever leaves your machine.
